name: releases
definition: The subject vendor or organization publishes or issues the object advisory, patch, or software update.

name: mitigates-vulnerability-in
definition: The subject security advisory or patch resolves security vulnerabilities in the target product or system.

name: affects
definition: The subject security flaw or vulnerability impacts or exists within the target software product or system.

name: located-in
definition: The subject entity is based, operates, or is geographically situated within the target country or territory.

name: part-of
definition: The subject entity is a component, sub-product, or constituent part of the target entity.

name: hosts
definition: The subject infrastructure, server, domain, or IP address hosts the target file, resource, or service.

name: delivers
definition: The subject malware, file, or campaign drops, executes, or installs the target payload or malware.
